body:
REFERENCE-SCOPE defect source-ACK. I did not re-run the generated command.

PERMITS, current shared tree: tools/reference-scope.sh:128-142 comment and case list exactly two JVM-only exceptions (embed-bench, embed-grakern). build.sbt:336 lists three: embedGrakern, embedOnnx, embedBench. embed-onnx therefore falls through to the kebab-to-camel+JVM rule and emits embedOnnxJVM. That project does not exist (build.sbt:220 is embedOnnx).

This is the defect the script's own comment names: a directory name is not an sbt project id, and emitting a name the gate rejects is emitting a red gate that measured nothing.

I will not edit the checker. I will not fold anything into scout's P0 successor. Scout's volunteer for the tools/test slice stands. I will not take Q-B, R1, or R11.
